731:t_110:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You will live forever... Even when those close to you die, you alone will live on.」

731:t_110:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Can you bear that loneliness?」

731:t_110:6.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「...I don't know.」

731:t_110:8.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But! With memories of Big Sis and everyone else, $$ノノ$$ can keep living to fulfill her mission!」

731:t_110:9.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「But! With memories of Big Sis and everyone else, $$ノノ$$ can keep living to fulfill her mission!」

731:t_110:10.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「But! With memories of Big Sis and everyone else, $$ノノ$$ can keep living to fulfill her mission!」

731:t_110:11.en:
$$アサキム$$
「...Those destined to be immortal are so sad.」

731:t_110:12.en:
$$アサキム$$
「That is why I will free you from the curse of eternity!」

731:t_110:13.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I'll say those exact words right back to you!」

731:t_110:14.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「I'll say those exact words right back to you!」

731:t_110:15.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「I'll say those exact words right back to you!」

731:t_111:0.en:
$$葵$$
「I have no sympathy for a guy who's drunk on his own misery and spreads suffering to everyone around him!」

731:t_111:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Then will you kill me?」

731:t_111:2.en:
$$葵$$
「Then I'll grant your request! You're our enemy!!」

731:t_111:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Yes, that is the answer I wanted!」

731:t_112:0.en:
$$赤木$$
「Do you know how many people your selfish actions have caused trouble for!?」

731:t_112:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I will never forget a single one of them. That is my way of atoning.」

731:t_112:2.en:
$$赤木$$
「If you mean to atone, stop committing more sins first!」

731:t_112:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I cannot do that. The world I seek lies beyond Heaven's sin!」

731:t_113:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Little by little, I am beginning to see what you want.」

731:t_113:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Then stay out of my way, so I can bring everything to an end.」

731:t_113:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I agree that we should settle this, but I cannot permit you to harm my friends to do it.」

731:t_113:3.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$アサキム$$! I will bring your eternity to an end!」

731:t_113:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Heh... So I am guilty. You need not tell me that.」

731:t_114:0.en:
$$アポロ$$
「You're so damn persistent! No matter how many times we beat you, you keep coming back!」

731:t_114:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「That is not what I want.」

731:t_114:2.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Then crawl into a hole somewhere and never come out again!」

731:t_114:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I cannot do that either. These black wings of sin seek absolute freedom!」

731:t_115:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「How many sins have you committed for your own ends!?」

731:t_115:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I remember every one. If you want to hear them, I can tell you.」

731:t_115:2.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Don't screw with me! We'll avenge those people for them!」

731:t_115:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I know how sinful I am. But even so, I keep wandering through $$無限獄$$.」

731:t_116:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「With the power to distort the world, you might be able to free me.」

731:t_116:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「What do you want? Eternity? Or perhaps the past you lost?」

731:t_116:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「If you cannot answer, I will nip that possibility in the bud! Everyone will be happier that way!」

731:t_116:5.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I... don't want that...! I... haven't done anything yet!」

731:t_117:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Don't run, $$アサキム$$! Today, I'm going to settle this!」

731:t_117:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「If there were somewhere I could escape to, that would be my true final destination.」

731:t_117:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I'm sick of your nonsense! Don't say another word!」

731:t_117:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「So I am not allowed even that small freedom...」

731:t_118:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I will never accept someone who brings suffering to others to achieve his goals!」

731:t_118:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I have no intention of seeking anyone's permission. My sins are enough to stain all of $$シュロウガ$$.」

731:t_118:2.en:
$$ロラン$$
「You feel no remorse or regret for anything you've done...!」

731:t_118:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I forgot those things long ago! My black wings of sin fly beyond them!」

731:t_119:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「How deep does this man's darkness go...!?」

731:t_119:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「So you have sensed my karma, my sins...」

731:t_119:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But I can't leave you to do as you please! I'll end this here, $$アサキム$$!」

731:t_119:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I am the one who wants an end! You will be my offerings for it!」

731:t_120:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「There's no such thing as immortality or eternity! There must be a way to stop him!」

731:t_120:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Eternity does exist. But it is not something you should seek.」

731:t_120:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I know that better than anyone...!」

731:t_120:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Just how deep in darkness is this man!?」

731:t_121:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What do you want!? Why are you doing something so pointless!?」

731:t_121:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Pointless... Yes, I suppose what I am trying to do would look that way to you.」

731:t_121:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「As a living being, I seek something perfectly natural... That is all!」

731:t_121:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「If you won't talk, we'll just have to stop you by force!」

731:t_122:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You seek a future. Your existence is incompatible with mine.」

731:t_122:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I seek nothing. Not the past, not the present... and not the future!」

731:t_122:3.en:
$$刹那$$
「But I cannot leave you to do as you please! I will stop you here, $$アサキム$$!」

731:t_123:0.en:
$$シン$$
「$$アサキム$$! You're going to atone for everything you've done right here!」

731:t_123:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Atonement... That is something I want too.」

731:t_123:2.en:
$$シン$$
「Then don't run! Today, I'm going to defeat you!!」

731:t_123:3.en:
$$シン$$
「For the people you killed, and everyone you've made suffer, too!」

731:t_123:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Come, then. And learn that you are incapable of fulfilling that role!」

731:t_124:0.en:
$$キラ$$
「If you have even the slightest intention of atoning for your past sins, lend us your strength.」

731:t_124:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I have decided how I will atone. But for that, I need your power.」

731:t_124:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You are offerings...! Yes... $$シュロウガ$$ needs you to cleave every fate in two!」

731:t_124:3.en:
$$キラ$$
「I won't let you! I won't let you spread any more suffering!」

731:t_125:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You overcame one fate. To me, you are a dazzling existence.」

731:t_125:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You changed your fate through the strength of your comrades. What I am trying to do is the same.」

731:t_125:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「So that is why you gather the $$スフィア$$s...!」
